svg.title: Wes McKinney at Kenn Software
svg.desc: A 16-bit Wes McKinney floats cross-legged in meditation, orbited by Kenn Software projects: AgentsView (what your agents did, what it cost), roborev (local, continuous code review), Ghosthub (all your multiplexers, one terminal), msgvault (keep and search your messages), Kenn Forge (agent workspace with forge sync), kata (the issue tracker inside the loop), Docbank (agent-native document vault), kwt (Git worktrees for people and agents), Fotobank (photo system of record you control), BenchDB (performance results, in context).
svg.text: > agentic systems for what comes next. █
